# ADR-3116: A10: Webhook callback to RFC1918 for integration 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Private callbacks expose internal services.

## Decision

Integrations MUST NOT permit a webhook callback to RFC1918 for integration 8 (A10-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Callbacks require public verified endpoints.
